findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_events, get_my_usage · Private data: get_coverage, describe_fields, export_companies_csv · Public sink: search_person, get_my_usage · Destructive: get_coverage.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_events, get_my_usage · Private data: get_coverage, describe_fields, export_companies_csv · Public sink: search_person, get_my_usage · Destructive: get_coverage

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
